en.title: Rolling Outages Begin Tonight
en.text: CITY POWER COMPANY announces planned rolling outages, Tuesday 22:00-23:00, suburban feeders first. 'A maintenance formality,' says the director. Asked about the night-shift request for feeder four, the director ended the call.

clippings.source_en: Civic leaflet, reproduced in the Herald

en.title: Collection Point at the Central Arena
en.text: Residents are to proceed orderly to the central arena. Documents and one bag per person. Do not remain outdoors after dark. The Herald notes the order carries no signature and no office, and that the arena's own lights were seen off at press time.

en.title: Park Closed After 'Tree' Complaints
en.text: The central park closes until further notice following repeated complaints that the trees 'lean toward the lamps to listen'. The parks office: trees do not listen. Night gardeners, unnamed, add that the leaning started the week the new feeder hummed.

clippings.source_en: Herald archives, found in hospital records

en.title: Council Denies 'Grid Memory' Program
en.text: The council denies funding any 'Project Architect' to 'store what the lamps have seen'. The denial names the project by title, which no reporter had used. The program's test feeders, records show, were wired through the hospital sub-feed and the park line.

en.title: Meters Run Backwards on Three Streets
en.text: Apartment meters on three residential streets record negative draw at night. City Power blames 'faulty drums'. A retired meterman: a backwards meter is not a faulty drum, it is a tap. Something downstream is paying current into the wires, not taking it.
